summary: Join our training on humanitarian logistics in emergencies. Learn effective strategies to manage resources and improve response efforts in critical times.
lede: Humanitarian logistics moves relief items from assessed needs through procurement, transport, storage and distribution. Designed for professionals who manage or support emergency operations, the course covers prioritizing supplies, managing vendors and routes, tracking inventory and pipelines, and coordinating last-mile delivery. Participants also practice managing risks, documenting decisions, and reporting constraints, costs and results under pressure.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who manage or support emergency logistics and supply chain operations.
audience: Humanitarian logistics officers and supply chain staff
Emergency coordinators and field operations leads
Procurement and contract management professionals in relief
Government disaster management and relief personnel
modules: Foundations of Humanitarian Logistics in Emergencies
Rapid Needs Assessment and Supply Planning
Transport, Fleet, and Routing Under Constraints
Warehousing and Inventory Management in the Field
Pipeline Management and Logistics Information Systems
Risk, Security, and Compliance in Emergency Logistics
Budgeting, Cost Control, and Value for Money in Logistics
Communicating Logistics Decisions and Reporting Results
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of logistics and supply chain management principles, preferably with experience in humanitarian or emergency response settings.
